_about: Public-domain Clarence Edward Macartney (1879-1957), Presbyterian minister in Philadelphia and Pittsburgh, for the Word Hoard: The Parables of the Old Testament, Truths Tested by the World War, Shall Unbelief Win? (his answer to Fosdick), Twelve Great Questions about Christ, Putting on Immortality, Of Them He Chose Twelve, Christianity and Common Sense, Paul the Man, and Sons of Thunder. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 135 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. He lived past 1930, so only printings dated before 1930 are shelved; those are public domain in the US. No uids minted.
